skala_max_attribute_length_for_same_line #

Arrangement of attributes — Place attribute section list on separate line if it is longer than ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against the oracle at 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified masked. Masked by skala_place_attribute_on_same_line = false, the export's own value: with no attribute ever joined to its member there is no length for this key to threshold, and both engines are flat at 120 and 10. Set skala_place_field_attribute_on_same_line = true and the oracle gives three distinct outputs over 120/0/1/10 while Skala stays flat. ⚠ The int probe is degenerate here in the way the harness warns about: 0 and 1 produce the same output, so only 120 against 10 discriminates.

Typeinteger
Default120
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet
Languagecsharp
Since0.1
